products.name: No. 04 Sculptural Bronze & Fluted Alabaster Table Lamp
products.shortDescription: Hand-cast solid bronze arm with honed Spanish alabaster shade, offering soft directional illumination.
products.description: Conceived in collaboration with Parisian foundry artisans, the No. 04 table lamp marries solid patinated bronze with translucent honed Spanish alabaster. Each lamp exhibits distinct mineral veining, turning direct illumination into an atmospheric, warm ambient glow. Features an integrated touch dimmer switch concealed within the base.

specifications.value: Cast solid bronze, Honed Spanish alabaster

products.name: Sovereign Double-Faced Cashmere Overcoat
products.shortDescription: Unstructured, hand-stitched double-faced Mongolian cashmere tailored in oat beige with horn buttons.
products.description: The Sovereign Overcoat is constructed from 650gsm pure Mongolian cashmere, split and hand-finished along every interior seam with invisible blind stitching. Featuring a relaxed raglan shoulder, generous calf length, real horn buttons, and cupro-lined sleeves for effortless layering over heavy tailoring.

products.name: Cavalier Full-Grain Bridle Leather Weekender
products.shortDescription: Vegetable-tanned Tuscan bridle leather travel tote with solid brass hardware and suede lining.
products.description: Designed for brief continental journeys, the Cavalier Weekender is bench-made from 2.8mm vegetable-tanned Tuscan bridle leather that develops an extraordinary warm patina over decades of movement. Reinforced with hand-set copper saddle rivets, heavy RiRi zippers, and an interior divider lined in glove-soft suede.

products.name: Aethel Travertine Centerpiece Plinth Bowl
products.shortDescription: Monolithic fluted Roman travertine vessel carved from a single block of unpolished stone.
products.description: Each Aethel centerpiece is carved from select blocks of Italian porous travertine stone. Kept matte and untreated to celebrate naturally formed cavity fissures and pale ivory tones, it functions with architectural presence either as a fruit display or solitary sculptural centerpiece.

reviews.title: An architectural masterwork in our living room
reviews.comment: The weight of the cast bronze is remarkable. In the evening, the alabaster diffuses light with the warmth of candlelight. Every visitor asks where it was acquired.

reviews.title: Supreme cashmere quality and tailoring
reviews.comment: Having owned outerwear from Milan and Savile Row, the hand-finishing on this coat is peerless. It drapes naturally without any rigidity and is exceptionally warm.

reviews.title: Heirloom quality bridle leather
reviews.comment: Took it on a weekend trip to Zurich. Sturdy, smells incredible, and the brass hardware is substantial. Will likely pass this down.
